entities.summary: Travis Sanheim is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman and alternate captain for the Philadelphia Flyers of the National Hockey League (NHL). Sanheim was selected by the Flyers in the first round, 17th overall, of the 2014 NHL entry draft.
